summary.tldr: The Planning Board discussed restarting the long-dormant RD Pilesgrove (formerly Kapsalis) major subdivision at Sound Avenue from the preliminary stage with a new application fee and SEQRA review, and approved a resolution legalizing improvements at Great Rock Golf Club.

sections.heading: Key actions
items: The board approved Resolution 2026-062, granting administrative site plan approval to legalize clearing and drainage improvements at Great Rock Golf Club in Wading River.
The board approved the September 3, 2026 meeting minutes.
The chair gave an update that a stop-work order remains in effect on the Summerwind project while the town negotiates with the applicant.

sections.heading: Discussed
items: For the RD Pilesgrove LLC (formerly Kapsalis) subdivision at 3544 Sound Avenue, the applicant's engineers and town planning staff discussed restarting the application at preliminary approval with a new fee, updated SEQRA (coordinated) review, and eventual public hearing, since the original 2008 final conditional approval has lapsed beyond allowable extensions.

Staff and board members discussed open space and preservation percentages for the subdivision, noting the plan currently shows about 61% land area preserved versus the town's 70% target, and considered reducing the lot yield to possibly avoid Long Island Workforce Housing Act requirements and a mandatory Type 1 SEQRA classification.
